item.title: AI-fueled Cyberattacks Drive Claims Surge at Japan Insurers
item.description: Japan’s biggest property insurers are reporting a sharp jump in cyber insurance claims as artificial intelligence-driven attacks grow more sophisticated and hacking incidents surge nationwide.

item.title: Goldman’s Moe on Uncertainties Around the AI Trade
item.description: Goldman Sachs Chief Regional Equity Strategist for Asia Pacific Timothy Moe describes some of the broader pressures on AI-related stocks. He speaks as investors contend with worries over Nvidia, political developments in the US and opposition to data centers. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Taiwan’s Stock Benchmark Plunges 18% in Worst Week Since 1991
item.description: Taiwan’s tech-heavy stock market witnessed another selloff on Friday as the global artificial intelligence trade came under further strain, sending the island’s benchmark to its worst week since 1991.

item.description: "Bloomberg: The Asia Trade" brings you everything you need to know to get ahead as the trading day begins in Asia. item.title: IDR/USD: Why Indonesia’s Rupiah Is So Weak And What It Means For the Economy
item.description: Indonesia’s rupiah — Asia’s worst-performing currency this year — has been under pressure since late 2024, as investors have grown increasingly concerned about the country’s fiscal outlook. Before the current period of volatility, the currency hadn’t traded at such low levels since the Asian Financial Crisis of 1997-98.
